games.name: Laser Pointer
games.score: seconds the cat stays within one cell of the dot
games.rules: Drag the dot around the room and the cat chases it. Each second it stays within one cell of the dot scores. Personality changes chase speed and lines only.

games.name: Knock It Off
games.rules: A shelf holds five objects. Tap when the cat's paw is over one to knock it off; consecutive hits chain. Personality changes paw speed and lines only.

games.name: String Chase
games.rules: Draw a path with one finger; the cat follows the string and collects the five sparkles along it. Personality changes chase speed and lines only.
